tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Submission of documents by authorized dealers, including the Goods and Services Tax (GST) certificate and account number details.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers must possess 15 years of experience in supplying grocery items and providing related services. Submission of documents.
Must have mandatorily supplied grocery items to government or semi-government departments. Submission of a satisfactory service certificate.
Submission of documents by authorized dealers, including the Goods and Services Tax (GST) certificate and account number details
Submission of the establishment registration certificate from the Labour Department.
A certificate of similar work performed, issued by the supplier, must be submitted. The tenderer must have had a financial turnover of at least Rs. 10.00 crore over the last two years.
Tenderers must submit Income Tax (IT) returns for the last three years: 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26.
Mandatory submission of the Import-Export Code (IEC) certificate.
Submission of the certificate from the Department of Legal Metrology.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A certificate of similar work performed, issued by the supplier, must be submitted. The tenderer must have had a financial turnover of at least Rs. 10.00 crore over the last two years.
Mandatory submission of the Import Export Code certificate.
Submission of the establishment registration certificate from the Labour Department.
Tenderers must possess 15 years of experience in supplying grocery items and providing related services. Submission of documents.
Tenderers must submit a 50 PERCENT solvency certificate.
Tenderers must submit Income Tax returns for the last three years.
